verdict.rationale: The Nevada Secretary of State is a state government business-filing registry. Records are held by the state as a public authority, so a user-selectable storage region or residency option is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains only robots and bot-wall probes, which say nothing about data residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
